scope: Independent design and implementation review of qm_charpoly_checked_v1 and qm_charpoly_ungated_v1, plus targeted token-aware Pareto reporting change. No original corpus expansion.

findings.title: Helper and runner registry contracts initially disagreed
findings.finding: Initial helper lacked source_pins/checked/scope and used name instead of id; runner would fail before dispatch.
findings.resolution: Aligned stage IDs and plan metadata, with process-frozen source/build/binary pins. Actual runner failure-path tests now load and execute the plans.

findings.title: Returned infrastructure status could bypass the stop condition
findings.finding: Initial helper returned host_infrastructure_failure but runner stopped only on INFRASTRUCTURE_REFUSAL. After other API repairs, a returned native failure could have caused a paid repair or ungated synthesis. The original raised-exception test did not cover this path.
findings.resolution: The helper now emits canonical INFRASTRUCTURE_REFUSAL. Both actual-helper-returned failure tests pass with one settled proposal charge, no further calls and answerNone.

findings.title: Runner initially bypassed bounded raw repair context
findings.finding: Initial runner forwarded the original proposal verbatim rather than using helper.stage_request; a response rejected for size could have entered repair without the declared8192-byte forwarding bound. Accounting still applied; no overspend was demonstrated.
findings.resolution: Runner now uses stage_request for actual charpoly message material. Independent actual-runner control retained40000raw bytes, forwarded8192bytes, then refused two invalid proposals with no synthesis.

claims.claim: The native acceptance result is an exact polynomial identity within the admitted carrier, not a finite-sample probability statement.
claims.basis: Each coefficient polynomial has per-variable degree<=4. A full Cartesian product of five distinct nodes per variable suffices by repeated univariate polynomial interpolation. Native values use exact rational arithmetic; the registered public Pauli transport fixes basis and input semantics.
limits: Depends on native arithmetic/source custody and registered public input interpretation.
Certifies only the characteristic polynomial, not eigenvectors, projectors, evolution or whole-task prose.

claims.claim: Candidate coefficients, host-created assertion, public matrix and native-build evidence are bound, while the final solve answer is explicitly uncertified.
limits: The assertion checksum binds an intermediate machine-readable statement, not a semantic interpretation of arbitrary later prose.
A correct polynomial can coexist with an incorrect synthesized answer.

claims.claim: The paired arms expose identical proposal/solve instructions and verdict-free solver context for an identical candidate. Only checked flow allows one bounded repair and requires acceptance before synthesis.
limits: The intervention bundles one repair opportunity with gating; this is not a separate causal estimate of each component.
Checked and ungated worst-case output allocations differ16800versus14400tokens, and successful paths can use two or three calls. Report actual cost/tokens/time and all attempts.
A single run per arm on one item cannot establish general efficacy.

claims.claim: Preflight precedes candidate dispatch; unknown billing and host infrastructure failure stop progression; known paid charges remain settled.
limits: Money caps depend on the guarded provider quote/enforcement premises; these tests do not authenticate an external provider.
Native preflight/hash custody is local integrity evidence, not protection against coordinated source/receipt/binary replacement by a trusted host operator.

claims.claim: Model requests carry public inputs/schema and candidate-derived content; repair receives only one bounded public arithmetic mismatch or schema code, not a full native coefficient response, evaluator rubric or hidden solution.
limits: The repair witness intentionally reveals a native value at one public input point. It is permitted public computation, not statistical independence or secrecy from the model provider.
Untrusted raw text remains model context; this labeling is not a proof that an LLM will ignore embedded instructions. Tools and retries remain disabled at dispatch.

claims.claim: Observed Pareto dominance now includes total provider-reported input+output tokens in addition to score, money and wall time.
limits: Unavailable token usage excludes only Pareto eligibility, not raw reporting.
Reasoning tokens are not added a second time. Descriptive within-item frontier membership is not an established population advantage.

validation.method: Selected existing actual-runner pytest cases, with NativeHost.compute replaced by a fail-fast sentinel and verified never called. Network already forbidden by the test fixture.
Actual runner with two invalid offline proposals, native execution disabled.

Five pure-Python dominance controls: extra tokens block cheaper/faster dominance; reverse tradeoff blocks; equal tokens permit cost dominance; unknown tokens block eligibility; identical points do not strictly dominate.
